skills.when_to_use: Use whenever an answer or artifact rests on information you fetched rather than knew, and needs inline numbered citations plus a verifiable Sources block.

skills.name: llm-wiki
skills.description: Karpathy's LLM Wiki: build/query interlinked markdown KB.
skills.when_to_use: Use when the user asks to create, build, or start a wiki, ingest a source into a wiki, ask a question about an existing wiki, or lint/audit/health-check a wiki.

skills.name: reference-doc-fact-audit
skills.description: Audit a study reference doc for factual errors, then fix.
skills.when_to_use: Use when the user asks to audit, fact-check, verify, or fix a study or technical reference document the agent or a model wrote earlier.

skills.name: study-roadmap-builder
skills.description: Build folder-structured quarterly study/learning roadmaps.
skills.when_to_use: Use when the user wants to build a folder-structured quarterly study/learning roadmap with specific sub-fields per quarter, or to teach a section from an existing roadmap.

skills.name: skill-design
skills.description: Authors, improves, and prunes agent skills: --create builds a skill from a job description; --improve audits and repairs an existing skill; --prune merges duplicate skills into one folder.
skills.when_to_use: Author a new SKILL.md for a slash command that has no loaded skill; improve an existing SKILL.md (audit + repair in one pass); or prune duplicate or same-purpose skills into one folder.

skills.name: skill-traces
skills.description: Learns from, evolves, and unlearns skills from Grok Build session traces in one pass. --learn creates skills for repeated hand-typed instructions and open gaps; --evolve fixes stale lines in loaded skills; --unlearn retires skills the traces show are never used. Deterministic counts and repeated-phrase material come from the trace pipeline (usage.json, phrases.json); a narrow window lists but does not retire.
skills.when_to_use: Use when the user wants to learn new skills from repeated hand-typed instructions, evolve stale skill lines to match current reality, or retire skills the traces show they never use. Pick one or more modes: --learn, --evolve, --unlearn; the trace pipeline runs once and every mode applies its own action kinds.

skills.name: design
skills.description: Orchestrates a write-review-revise loop using `design-doc-writer` and `design-doc-reviewer` subagents to produce a polished design document and PR plan.
skills.when_to_use: Use when asked to write a design doc, produce a system architecture/spec, or via the `/design <description>` slash command. Triggers: 'design a feature', 'write a design doc', 'create technical spec'. Also acts as a step dependency inside `execute-plan`.

skills.name: execute-plan
skills.description: Executes a PR Plan DAG end-to-end: Hermes validates the plan and drops /execute-plan into Grok Build (Grok runs parallel Orca worktrees, implementers, the 3-reviewer panel, fix loops, and final assembly), then Hermes verifies the final branch and ships the PR.
skills.when_to_use: Use for /execute-plan <design-doc-path>, execute plan, run the plan, implement the design, or after /design produces a PR plan.

skills.name: implement
skills.description: Run the implement → review → fix loop for a single small-to-medium task in one Orca worktree: Hermes plans the brief, drops /implement into Grok Build (Grok runs the full loop with its 3-reviewer panel), then Hermes verifies, commits, pushes, and opens the PR.
skills.when_to_use: Use when asked to implement, build, add a feature, fix a bug, or via the /implement slash command. Best for tasks that fit in one worktree. For multi-PR stacks with dependencies, use /execute-plan instead.

skills.name: design-md
skills.description: Author/validate/export Google's DESIGN.md design-token spec files.
skills.when_to_use: Use when the user wants a DESIGN.md design-token spec file — authoring, linting, diffing, or exporting to Tailwind or W3C DTCG JSON; also for WCAG contrast validation on color palettes.

skills.name: p5js
skills.description: p5.js sketches: gen art, shaders, interactive, 3D.
skills.when_to_use: Use when the user wants a p5.js sketch — generative art, shaders, interactive visualizations, canvas animations, 3D WebGL scenes, audio-reactive visuals, or data viz, exported as HTML/PNG/GIF/MP4/SVG.

skills.name: popular-web-designs
skills.description: 54 real design systems (Stripe, Linear, Vercel) as HTML/CSS.
skills.when_to_use: Use when the user wants a page styled like a known site — 'build a page that looks like Stripe/Linear/Vercel', a landing page, dashboard, or UI using a real design system's tokens and components.

skills.name: pretext
skills.description: Build creative browser demos with DOM-free text layout.
skills.when_to_use: Use when the user wants a pretext creative demo — text flowing around a moving shape, ASCII-art effects using real words, text-as-geometry games, kinetic typography, multiline shrink-wrap UI, or per-glyph physics.
